subject: Post-call recap: trial environment governance, success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lawson <emma@healthguard.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: POC scope & trial environment options

Emma — thanks for the call earlier today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan. I captured action ownership and a recommended environment path for the 4-week POC. Please call out anything I missed.

Quick recap (agreed on call)
- Goal / success criteria:
  - Latency <= 150ms p50 for normal query set (50–100 tokens).
  - Throughput: sustain 20 concurrent users with 2–3 reqs/sec each.
  - Quality: responses match current templates > 92% by our eval set (we'll share the prompt set).
  - No PHI persistence in hosted logs — HealthGuard requires session-only KV retention.
- Evaluation plan:
  - Week 1: environment provisioning + smoke tests (latency/throughput).
  - Week 2–3: feature tests + quality evaluation using your 150 prompts.
  - Week 4: load ramp + handoff/decision meeting.
- Environment options discussed (pros/cons):
  1) Redwood Hosted (fastest to start, easiest for integration, limited by our multi-tenant logging controls)
  2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPUs, isolated instance, best proxy for perf and security)
  3) VPC Private (customer-managed VPC, required for strict network controls — longer lead time)

Recommended path: start with Redwood Hosted sandbox for a 3–5 day smoke test, then flip to Dedicated sandbox for the full trial if perf or data isolation look critical. If HealthGuard policy requires VPC from day one, we can prioritize that but expect ~3–4 week lead time.

Proposed kickoff & owners:
- Kickoff (smoke): Mon Mar 15 — Dylan to provision hosted sandbox and run smoke tests.
- Dedicated provisioning (if chosen): Mar 22–26 — Marissa to own infra provisioning.
- Security / compliance answers: Ben to coordinate SOC/compliance docs and KMS options.

Attachments: POC_Scope_v1.pdf (scope, data handling assumptions, sample prompt set)

Next steps (please reply with confirmation):
1) Confirm preferred initial environment (Hosted vs Dedicated vs VPC)
2) Confirm the 150-prompt evaluation set is the latest — Emma to share any additional edge cases
3) Approve kickoff date (Mar 15) or propose an alternative

Thanks — I can walk through the provisioning plan on a quick 15-minute call if helpful.

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai/
From: Emma Lawson <emma@healthguard.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@healthguard.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC scope & trial environment options

Thanks Dylan — really helpful recap. Agree with the proposed success criteria and timeline. A couple of notes from our side: 
- We prefer to start with a Hosted sandbox for the smoke tests to validate integration, but HealthGuard policy likely requires Dedicated sandbox for the full trial because of log retention rules.
- I'll share the 150-prompt set by EOD today; adding 12 prompts for edge cases (PII redaction scenarios).
- Procurement (cc Rajiv) will need an intercompany MSA/PO path for the Dedicated sandbox if we move forward.

Confirming kickoff for the smoke test: Mar 15 works for us. Please share any onboarding steps we need to complete (API keys, allowlisted IPs, sample corpus upload).

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC scope & trial environment options

Thanks Emma — great. Quick clarifications and a concrete plan so procurement has the pieces they need for Dedicated if you decide to go that route.

1) Hosted smoke (Mar 15) — what we'll deliver:
  - Short-lived API key for your test account (no long-term logs persisted beyond session TTL)
  - Sample prompt ping script and 10k token load test harness
  - Baseline perf numbers (p50/p95) and an initial quality report against your prompt set

2) Dedicated sandbox (recommended for full POC) — expected config & timelines:
  - Config: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs, 128GB sequence cache, isolated model instance, KV prefix caching disabled for PHI
  - Expected lead time: 5–7 business days once we have signed SOW and provisioning request (we can overlap some compliance checks)
  - Cost: we will share a time-limited trial credit; Ben, can you confirm the provisional pricing model we discussed?

3) VPC Private (only if required by policy):
  - Lead time: ~3–4 weeks (network setup + KMS + customer firewall ACLs)
  - We'll provide a checklist for your network/security team to speed this up

Action items: 
- Dylan: provision hosted sandbox and issue API key on Mon Mar 15 (smoke).
- Marissa: draft Dedicated provisioning ticket (Mar 15–16). Attach: trial-config-template.csv (config options request).
- Ben: send compliance doc pointers + provisional pricing for Dedicated (by EOD Mon).
- Emma / Rajiv: confirm procurement path for Dedicated SOW or confirm that Hosted->Dedicated flow is acceptable.

If you want a short technical kick-off with Marissa and Ben right after provisioning, we can do a 30-minute session to walk through integration steps and test harness.

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC scope & trial environment options

Looping in operations details so HealthGuard knows timing and what we need from them.

Provisioning checklist (high level):
- Hosted smoke (Mar 15):
  - Dylan to provision API key and sandbox instance. I will validate logging behavior and ensure session-only retention is configured.
  - HealthGuard items: provide allowlisted IPs (if you want to lock to your office IPs) and a small sample corpus (S3 link or .zip).
- Dedicated sandbox:
  - We need a signed SOW (I can attach a template).
  - Customer to provide KMS details if you want customer-managed keys (optional, recommended for PHI).
  - Expected tasks: provision GPU nodes -> install model variant -> run smoke tests -> handover. Typical window: 5–7 business days.
- VPC Private:
  - Network team to open ACLs, provide BGP/peering info (if applicable).
  - We will schedule a 1-hour network call to collect firewall rules.

Security notes: we will disable KV cache for any PHI traffic, logs will be redacted, and we can add explicit retention TTLs in the SOW. I attached a short provisioning-checklist.md with step-by-step tasks.

I will start the Dedicated provisioning ticket on Mon (Mar 15) and attach the trial-config-template.csv for HealthGuard to populate.
